problems.title: Row sums, column sums and total
problems.statement: Read n and m (up to 100) and an n by m matrix of integers. Print each row sum on its own line, then all column sums on one line, then the total.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Matrix array is 10x10 but the grid can be 100x100.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Column sum starts at row 1 and skips row 0.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Row sum is not reset to zero.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Total is overwritten instead of accumulated.

problems.title: Both diagonals of a square matrix
problems.statement: Read n (up to 500) and an n by n integer matrix. Print the sum of the main diagonal and the sum of the anti-diagonal separated by a space.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Matrix array only 8x8 but n can be 500.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Anti-diagonal column index is one too far.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Diagonal sum is never initialised.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong formula: takes the last column instead of the anti-diagonal.

problems.title: Rotate a vector left
problems.statement: Read n and k (k up to 1000000000) then n integers. Rotate the sequence left by k positions and print it on one line.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: k is not reduced modulo n so the index runs far past the end.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Source index is one too far, rotating by k+1.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Rotates right instead of left.

problems.title: Score histogram
problems.statement: Read n and then n scores from 0 to 100. Print 11 lines, one per bucket of ten (0, 10, ..., 100), each as the bucket start, a colon, and one star per score in that bucket.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Only 10 buckets but a score of 100 needs an eleventh.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Bucket index off by one: multiples of 10 land in the lower bucket.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Bucket counters not zeroed.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Prints the bucket number instead of its start value.

problems.title: k-th element from the end
problems.statement: Read n, then n integers, then q and q queries k (1 <= k <= n). For each query print the k-th element counting from the end (k = 1 is the last element).

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Array of 8 slots for up to 100000 numbers.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Index from the end is off by one.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Counts from the front instead of the end.

problems.title: Minesweeper counts

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot continue so mine cells also print a count.
